svg.title: Ledger
svg.desc: - 2026-10-18: Keep signed in. keepSession kept a site's cookies, but Canvas still signed out once its server-side session sat idle (Canvas renews its sealed session cookie on any request once it is five minutes old; the idle limit defaults to a day, 20 minutes at least). keepSignedIn in sites.json, a Keep signed in checkbox under each site in the window, and umbra keep-signed-in [site …] [--off]: a per-profile launch agent runs the command every ten minutes by the clock (and on wake for a visit missed during sleep), which requests each marked site's probe (or root), keeps the cookies it answers with, and logs one line per site. It goes through the daemon when one runs, without refreshing its idle timer, and never starts one. KeepSignedInTests (14) load real launchd jobs under test labels and boot them out; full suite green.
